title: Teen Birthday Day Out Ideas They’ll Actually Love
description: Teen birthday day out ideas: escape rooms, go-karting, laser tag, trampoline parks, climbing, theme parks and city trips, plus group booking tips.
intro: Too old for a bouncy castle, too young to go out alone? Here are birthday days out that teens will happily invite their mates to.

image.alt: Three go-karts racing around a bend

cardText: Escape rooms, karting, laser tag and more birthday ideas for teens.

blocks.title: Scout’s party tip
blocks.text: Ask about group or party packages. They often include extras like food or private time, and can work out cheaper per person.
points: Check the youngest guest meets age limits
Collect consent forms ahead if the venue needs them

sections.html:
• Go-karting: junior sessions with a podium finish.
  • Laser tag: team battles in neon arenas.
  • Trampoline parks: dodgeball courts and foam pits.
  • Climbing or bouldering: a taster session with instructors.

• Escape rooms: perfect for small groups.
  • Bowling plus pizza: a classic that still works.
  • A city day with a show or a studio tour.
A thrill park, a surf lesson or indoor skydiving makes a birthday unforgettable. Gift experiences can also be shared: see experience days.

faqs.q: What can I do for a 13th birthday?
faqs.a: Popular choices include escape rooms, go-karting, laser tag, trampoline parks, climbing walls and theme parks. Let them choose and invite a few friends.
